ploidyspec report: lpElePalu1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 19 chromosome numbers; the numbers form sets of 2 (7 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers), so x ≈ 7 and up to 4x relative to x.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 7 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers (genome partition z = 15.6); homeolog distance 0.020 vs unrelated 0.091

Auto-like or allo-like?

Auto-like origin, mostly rediploidized: the duplicated sets have separated along most of their length, but 10 of 19 paired chromosome numbers keep stretches where the homeologs are as close as alleles (residual tetrasomy). That is expected after an autopolyploidization; recent homeologous exchanges in an allopolyploid can leave similar stretches.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 18 chromosome numbers assessed: 4 split into lineages, 8 tetrasomic-like, 2 one divergent copy, 4 candidate; residual tetrasomy on 10/19 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers (5 pair(s)), 310.0 Mb, 52% of it terminal

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.0819

Rediploidization

Partly: 10 of 19 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers keep stretches of residual tetrasomy (310.0 Mb, 52% of it at chromosome ends) where the homeologs are still as close as alleles; elsewhere they have diverged. Also: 6 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr01:chr02+chr18, chr02:chr01+chr03+chr07+chr18, chr03:chr02+chr18, chr07:chr02+chr08, chr13:chr06+chr17, chr18:chr01+chr02+chr03): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.48), as when regions resolve at different times; homeologous-exchange candidates on 11 chromosome(s), stretches closer to the homeolog than to the own homolog (exchange, or a contig placed on the wrong chromosome).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 10/19 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers (5 pair(s)), 310.0 Mb, 52% of it terminal; pair-depth CV 0.54; homeology map: 69% of the genome in 108 homeolog blocks, 14 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.48; exchange: chr01(chr18:2/2);chr02(chr03:1/2;chr07:2/2;chr18:1/2);chr03(chr02:1/2);chr07(chr02:2/2;chr08:1/2);chr08(chr07:1/2);chr10(chr09:1/2);chr11(chr12:1/2);chr12(chr11:1/2);chr15(chr14:1/2);chr16(chr19:1/2);chr17(chr13:1/2)
